text:
evan: morning — noticed a cluster-wide rise in tiny-pod evictions in ap-northeast1 around 04:10 UTC. heatmap shows many nodes with 0.5 GPU holes and a few racks nearly empty. link: https://redwood.internal/gpu/heatmap?region=ap-northeast1

mira: yep. looks like a chain: NIC flaps on a subset of nodes -> kubelet cycles -> scheduler reschedules small pods respecting podAntiAffinity -> fragmentation. eviction_count +320 in 90m.

hao: I pulled node events, see repeated `NetworkUnreachable` and `KubeletRestart` on nodes rack-2-{5,6,9} between 04:07-04:12. dmesg shows `mlx5: port error` bursts.

infra-bot: [ANOMALY] stranded_gpus_estimate=26 in ap-northeast1. recommended action: descheduler consolidation and cordon flaky hosts.

kevin: we should avoid mass drains during peak. proposal: run descheduler targeting pods labeled `tiny-gpu=true` with `maxPodsToEvictPerNode=1`, canary in ap-northeast1-a first. then cordon top flaky nodes.

ev an: +1. also add temporary placement-suppress for new tiny pods to avoid refilling the racks while we defrag. I'll push an autoscaler annotation for 20m.

mira: watch warmpool pressure — previous consolidations caused CPU p95 to spike. set descheduler `maxUnreadyPercent=20`.

hao: canary ran: evicted 22 pods, freed 10 GPUs in two racks. p95 latency stable. starting cordon on rack-2-5/6, draining after relocation completes.

kevin: cost note: consolidation spike estimated +$12/hr during the window, logged under incident INC-2026-0402. cheaper than potential SLA penalties.

infra-bot: incident INC-2026-0402 created. severity: sev3. assignee: eng-platform oncall.

mira: postmortem draft points: root cause likely Mellanox firmware regression; scheduler reacting aggressively to transient NodeNotReady; mitigation: schedule firmware roll, add a descheduler-based auto-defrag when stranded_gpus > 10, and consider softer scheduler backoff for tiny pods.

ev an: action items: hao -> collect node dmesg + open hardware ticket; kevin -> record cost delta in incident; mira -> PR for scheduler scoring tweak `tiny-pack-eligible`; evan -> apply placement-suppress and follow up with infra-hardware.

hao: uploaded logs to infra ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INFRA-789. keeping last node cordoned for debugging.

ev an: closing thread; reopen if evictions rise again. :thumbsup:
